name: result_cache
summary: BLAKE3-keyed cache for GPU + Ollama + Cloud results. Memory LRU (100 entries) + disk JSON at ~/.cc/result_cache/. Same call (same model + same prompt + same params + same input_crystal) always hits. Surfaces hit_rate in cc chat feed.
engine_pattern: Two-tier: OrderedDict memory LRU front, blake3-prefix-sharded disk JSON files behind. Optional TTL per entry.

inbound_callers: core/lib/task_queue.py::TaskQueue.submit (cache lookup before dispatch + write on success)

guarantees: Deterministic — same canonical inputs → same key, every time
TTL-aware — stale entries evict on read
LRU memory front → hot entries always fast

stats_surface.hits_disk: disk-tier hits (promote to memory on hit)

usage_example:
from result_cache import ResultCache, compute_key
c = ResultCache()
key = compute_key('qwen2.5-coder:1.5b', 'hi', {}, '')
if (r := c.get(key)):
    print('cached:', r['result'])
else:
    out = run_model()
    c.put(key, out, model_id='qwen2.5-coder:1.5b', source='ollama')
